import ast,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
parent="5ef5ba7e811d31d8599857929f2b79219c5954d4"
base=pathlib.Path(".agent/tasks/production-readiness-20260917/evidence")
old=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",parent+":src/worker.py"])
baseline=json.loads((base/"worker-artifacts-causal-baseline-20260921.json").read_text())
green=json.loads((base/"worker-artifacts-green-20260921.json").read_text())
for capture in (baseline,green):
    assert not any(capture[k] for k in ("timed_out","stdout_truncated","stderr_truncated"))
meta=json.loads(baseline["stdout"])
assert meta["source_sha256"]["src/worker.py"]==hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()
assert baseline["exit_code"]==1 and "FAILED (failures=11)" in baseline["stderr"] and "ERROR:" not in baseline["stderr"]
assert green["exit_code"]==0 and "Ran 11 tests" in green["stderr"]
current_meta=json.loads(green["stdout"])
for path,digest in current_meta["source_sha256"].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,path
for path in ["src/core/parser_debug_artifacts.py","tests/test_worker_parser_artifact_safety.py"]:
    assert meta["source_sha256"][path]==current_meta["source_sha256"][path]
before=ast.parse(old)
after=ast.parse(pathlib.Path("src/worker.py").read_text())
protected=["_parse_card_via_apify","_parse_card_via_apify_subprocess_entry","_extract_apify_actual_cost_usd","_settle_operator_apify_cost_if_present"]
for name in protected:
    def body(tree):
        return ast.dump(next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==name))
    assert body(before)==body(after),name
ruff="/private/tmp/localos-backend-deps-v2-20260920.xYc0jK/venv/bin/ruff"
subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/arch","-arm64",ruff,"check","tests/test_worker_parser_artifact_safety.py"],check=True)
subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/arch","-arm64",ruff,"check","--select","F821,F822,F823","src/worker.py"],check=True)
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
subprocess.run(["df","-k","."],check=True)
print(json.dumps({"parent":parent,"parent_worker_sha256":hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest(),"protected_function_AST_parity":protected,"source_sha256":current_meta["source_sha256"],"baseline_source_is_exact_parent":True,"baseline_final_test_bytes_match":True}))
